title: 联合国候选人：活动不等于成效，如何让联合国重获信任？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We just wrapped up the UN Town Hall, the next Secretary-General, the stakes are high, six candidates and why they're the best person for the top job. This is what they had to say.
segments.zh: 联合国市政厅会议刚结束，下任秘书长责任重大。六位候选人阐述为何自己是最佳人选。

segments.en: Our responsibility is to make the UN relevant again, to deliver, to touch the hearts and souls of
segments.zh: 我们的责任是让联合国重新发挥作用，切实服务基层民众。

segments.en: people on the ground, to serve people on the ground, and not to confuse activity with impact.
segments.zh: 要服务基层，而非混淆活动与成效。

segments.en: Well, I believe moral authority is always needed, and you always need to speak out on the issues where violence of human rights have been, or where the violation of international law
segments.zh: 我认为道德权威始终必要，必须就人权侵犯或违反国际法的问题发声。

segments.en: and humanitarian law is there. But of course, you have to insist on finding ways to put people
segments.zh: 但当然，必须坚持寻找团结人民的方法。

segments.en: together. What we need to do is to restore this credibility of the UN as a valid interlocutor,
segments.zh: 我们需要恢复联合国作为可信对话方的信誉，并利用现有工具。

segments.en: and then use the tools at hand. I would like to see a UN that is back at the table in the scenarios of conflict. I would like to see a UN that has revealed trust,
segments.zh: 我希望看到联合国重回冲突谈判桌，重建信任并利用信任在实地取得成果。

segments.en: but has used that trust to deliver results on the ground. The UN must be more present,
segments.zh: 联合国必须更多出现在和平与安全领域。

segments.en: especially in the peace and security arena, that we would have moved from where we are today to a UN that is delivering better and peace and security, both on the prevention side
segments.zh: 从现状迈向一个在预防和结束冲突方面更好履职的联合国。

segments.en: and ending of conflict side. Because in reality, global security, peace and stability is
segments.zh: 因为实际上，全球安全、和平与稳定是
